brand.name: Salon
brand.tagline: A private Berlin marketplace for venues and small-format entertainers.

meta.siteDescription: A private Berlin marketplace where venues and small-format entertainers book with clear terms, calendars, and contact privacy.
meta.homeDescription: A private Berlin marketplace for venues and small-format entertainers. Create an account or sign in.
meta.homeKeywords: Berlin, marketplace, venues, entertainers, live music, booking
meta.applyDescription: Join Salon, Berlin's private booking marketplace for venues and entertainers.
meta.privacyDescription: How Salon handles member profile and booking data in compliance with GDPR and data protection laws.
meta.termsDescription: Terms of use for Salon, a coordination marketplace for Berlin venues and entertainers.
meta.cookiesDescription: How Salon uses cookies and tracking technologies on the marketplace platform.
meta.dpaDescription: GDPR-compliant data processing terms for Salon marketplace users.
meta.subProcessorsDescription: List of third-party service providers processing data on behalf of Salon.
meta.signInDescription: Sign in to Salon to enter the private marketplace.
meta.appDefaultDescription: Private member area for Salon accounts.
meta.marketplaceDescription: Your Salon dashboard for discovery, bookings, and calendar.

verification.title: Profile verification in progress
verification.body: Staff usually verify profiles within 3 business days. Until then you can search the marketplace, update your profile, set availability, and explore — but you won’t appear in discovery or be able to contact other members yet.
verification.contactLocked: Contact is available after staff verify your profile.

home.headline: Good rooms meet great live acts.
home.body: A private marketplace where Berlin venues and small-format entertainers book with clear terms, calendars, and contact privacy.
home.proofFallback: Curated for Berlin's independent rooms and acts.
home.principle1Body: Profiles stay members-only. Contacts unlock only after shortlist or an accepted direct request.
home.principle2Body: Applications and direct requests share one terms, agreement, and confirmation flow.
home.principle3Body: Native holds and confirmed blocks keep both calendars honest before the night.
home.footerNote: Salon is a private B2B marketplace. Not a consumer event platform.

apply.title: Create your Salon account
apply.body: Sign in and choose whether you are joining as an entertainer or a venue. Staff verify profiles for discovery within about 3 business days.
apply.termsLabel: I acknowledge the terms and privacy notice
apply.success: Account ready. Continue to the marketplace.
apply.signedOutHint: Sign in first to create your account.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Sign in with an OAuth provider to prove email ownership, then choose entertainer or venue.
signIn.unconfigured: No Auth.js providers are configured yet. Set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID/SECRET or GitHub OAuth credentials.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Salon
onboarding.approvalLabel: Next steps while verification is underway
onboarding.noAccount: Choose entertainer or venue to finish signup.

roleSelection.title: Choose your role
roleSelection.body: Pick one: entertainer or venue operator. This account type cannot be changed later without staff help.
roleSelection.entertainerDesc: Performers, musicians, and small acts seeking bookings
roleSelection.venueDesc: Venue owners and operators posting opportunities and booking acts
roleSelection.required: Please select a role to continue

roleMode.explainer: Your account is either entertainer or venue.
roleMode.applyExplainer: Accounts are single-role. Contact staff if you need a different account type.

profile.title: Profiles
profile.approvalPanelBody: Staff verify publication so you appear in discovery and can contact other members. Saving a draft does not change marketplace access.
profile.contactPrivacy: Contact methods stay private until shortlist or accepted direct request.
profile.checkVenueApproved: At least one venue profile verified
profile.languagePanelBody: Choose the interface language for Salon. This switches English and German for the marketplace.
profile.riderPlaceholderBody: Private PDF riders use the secured Blob boundary. Sandbox mode stores metadata keys only — never public URLs.
profile.riderUnconfigured: Private Blob is not provisioned yet. Set FILE_STORE=sandbox for local metadata demos after linking Blob for production.
profile.riderRegistered: Rider metadata registered. Bytes stay private to the file store boundary.
profile.riderNeedProfile: Save an entertainer profile before registering a rider.
profile.body: Maintain your entertainer act or venue organization. Drafts can be submitted for staff verification; contacts stay private.
profile.venuesBody: Venues are organizations. Creating one makes you the owner.
profile.noRoles: Choose entertainer or venue during signup first.
profile.portfolioBody: Links, YouTube videos, and images stay private to verified venue members.
profile.portfolioImagePending: Image registered — bytes stay on the private file boundary.
profile.venueSpacesBody: Optional rooms or stages within this venue.

membership.title: Venue membership
membership.lastOwnerError: Cannot remove the last active owner.
membership.userNotFound: No Salon account exists for that email yet.

marketplace.title: Private marketplace
marketplace.body: Role-segregated discovery for members. Contacts stay hidden until shortlist or accepted direct request.
marketplace.denied: Private marketplace access requires an active account.
marketplace.roleDeniedEntertainers: Only venue operators can browse entertainer profiles.
marketplace.roleDeniedVenues: Only entertainers can browse venue profiles and open opportunities.
marketplace.contactPrivacy: Contact details are never shown in discovery. Unlock happens only through the booking flow.
marketplace.entertainersBody: Verified acts available for Berlin bookings.
marketplace.venuesBody: Verified rooms and venues seeking acts.
marketplace.contactLocked: Contact is locked until shortlist or accepted direct request.
marketplace.bookingsBody: Shared terms and lifecycle for applications and requests.
marketplace.verificationContactLocked: Contact is available after staff verify your profile.
marketplace.requestActLocked: Send a direct request after your venue profile is verified.
marketplace.recentApplicationsEmpty: No submitted applications for your venues yet.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.body: Applications and direct requests share one booking engine. Agree terms here before agreement generation.
bookings.depositNotice: Deposit status is independent of confirmation. Salon never holds funds.
bookings.nextSteps: Next: propose and accept terms, then generate the sandbox agreement.
bookings.nextGenerate: Terms are agreed. Generate the sandbox agreement to collect both signatures.
bookings.nextSign: Review the German controlling text, then apply your sandbox signature.
bookings.nextConfirmed: Booking confirmed. Both calendars show confirmed blocks for this window.
bookings.sandboxBody: Sandbox only — not a production legal e-signature. German text is controlling.
bookings.waitingSignatures: Waiting for the other designated signer.
bookings.confirmedCalendars: Confirmed — both calendars are blocked for this booking window.
bookings.proposeBody: Creates an immutable terms snapshot. The other party must accept.
bookings.waitingAccept: Waiting for the other party to accept.
bookings.cancellationDefault: Either party may cancel until both signatures; after confirmation, 50% fee if cancelled within 7 days.
bookings.productionDefault: Venue provides house PA and basic lighting; act brings own instruments.
bookings.agreementPending: Agreement generation and dual signatures are the next slice. German text will control.
bookings.depositBody: Deposit status is independent — it never confirms a booking.
bookings.agreementNoticeBody: German agreement text is controlling. English is a labeled convenience translation of the same versioned terms.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Open time is available by default. Add unavailable blocks or tentative holds when you need to protect dates.
calendar.icsSubscribeBody: Copy this link into Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or Outlook. It only includes requested and confirmed bookings — not unavailable blocks or tentative holds. Calendar apps refresh on their own schedule.
calendar.confirmDelete: Remove this block from the calendar?
calendar.holdExpiresHint: When this hold stops blocking the calendar if not converted.
calendar.noResources: Create an entertainer profile or venue membership to manage a calendar.

directRequests.title: Direct requests
directRequests.body: Venues invite entertainers directly. Accepting unlocks contacts and opens a shared booking.
directRequests.noVenues: Join or create an approved venue before sending a direct request.
directRequests.acceptedHint: Accepted — contacts are unlocked and a booking is open.

opportunities.listBody: Approved entertainers can apply once per opportunity.
opportunities.shortlistedHint: Shortlisted — contact details are unlocked for both sides.
opportunities.needApprovedProfile: Staff must verify your entertainer profile before you can apply. Verification usually takes about 3 business days.

admin.title: Staff review
admin.body: Suspend accounts for abuse and verify profile publication with a recorded reason. Operations surfaces stay read-mostly and never show unlocked contact values.
admin.profilesBody: Verify, request changes, or suspend entertainer and venue profiles for discovery and contact.
admin.opsBody: Inspect bookings, unlocks, memberships, riders, agreements, and audit events. Deposit corrections stay on booking detail.
admin.unlocksPrivacy: Reasons and timestamps only — contact values are never listed here.

cookies.modalDescription: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and provide essential functionality. You can customize your preferences or accept all cookies.
cookies.usageDescription: We use cookies and similar technologies to provide essential functionality and improve your experience on Salon.
cookies.necessaryDescription: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They include authentication, security, and basic functionality.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Optional analytics cookies are not enabled yet. If Salon adds a privacy-reviewed analytics provider later, you will be able to opt in here.
cookies.marketingDescription: Marketing cookies are not used. This category remains reserved so consent can be collected before any advertising tags are added.
cookies.functionalityDescription: Optional functionality cookies are not used beyond essential session and security cookies.
cookies.moreInfoDescription: For more details about how we use cookies and your data, please read our {privacyLink} and {cookieLink}.
cookies.gaCookieDesc: Reserved — Google Analytics is not provisioned.
cookies.gidCookieDesc: Reserved — Google Analytics is not provisioned.
cookies.clarityCookieDesc: Reserved — Microsoft Clarity is not provisioned.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for that action.
errors.validation: Please check the form and try again.
errors.invalid_transition: That state change is not allowed.
errors.stale_version: This booking changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.conflict: That action conflicts with the current state.

accountDeletion.dangerZoneBody: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Your data will be anonymized for legal and business purposes, but all personal information will be removed.
accountDeletion.deleteAccountDescription: Once you delete your account, all your personal information will be permanently anonymized. This action cannot be reversed.
accountDeletion.warningPoint1: Your personal information (name, email, image) will be permanently anonymized
accountDeletion.warningPoint2: All your contact methods will be anonymized
accountDeletion.warningPoint3: You will be immediately signed out
accountDeletion.warningPoint4: Your data will be kept for business analysis but will not identify you
accountDeletion.challengeInstructions: To confirm deletion, type DELETE or your email address:

notifications.title: Notifications & Alerts
notifications.body: Configure how you receive updates about bookings, applications, requests, and calendar changes.
notifications.notificationsBody: Choose which notifications you want to receive and how.
notifications.marketingBody: Control whether you want to receive marketing emails and updates about Salon.
notifications.marketingConsent: I want to receive marketing emails and updates
notifications.marketingConsentBody: Stay informed about new features, marketplace tips, and Berlin entertainment news. You can withdraw consent at any time.
